title: ATV proximity-ops abort criteria
body: ESA Automated Transfer Vehicle (ATV) shall abort approach if range-rate at 11 m exceeds 0.06 m/s, or if relative attitude error > 1 deg. Abort to S2 hold (250 m) and re-attempt after ground review.

title: JAXA HTV free-flight to capture
body: HTV (Kounotori) approach uses free-flight to 10 m, then ISS Canadarm2 captures. RV approach is suspended if Canadarm2 health is degraded or operator (typically JAXA + NASA crew) is unavailable.

title: Hibernation entry criteria
body: ESA Rosetta deep-space hibernation engaged when solar input drops below threshold for sustained ops (~3 AU). Spacecraft attitude biased to spin about sun line; only on-board clock + heaters active. Wake-up command stored on-board with timer-based execution.

title: BepiColombo solar electric propulsion duty cycle
body: ESA/JAXA BepiColombo SEP thrusters duty-cycle ~80 % during cruise; remaining 20 % reserved for navigation tracking, attitude maneuvers, and thermal recovery. Continuous SEP > 14 days requires ground re-authorisation.
